entities.summary: Isaiah Todd is an American professional basketball player for Kaohsiung Steelers of the P. League+. He was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the best power forwards in the 2020 class. A former Michigan commit, Todd chose to forgo his college eligibility to become the last player to sign with NBA G League Ignite before it ceased operations. He finished his high school career at the Word of God Christian Academy in Raleigh, North Carolina.
